indicator_name: Financial results of large and medium enterprises: profit of profit-makers and loss of loss-makers by NACE section and region, quarterly, million KZT
description: Финансовые результаты крупных и средних предприятий: сумма прибыли и сумма убытка по видам деятельности (ОКЭД) и регионам, поквартально, млн тенге
methodology: Taldau 703196 (profit of the enterprises that made a profit) and 703199 (loss of the loss-makers, negative), large and medium enterprises (size term 3629963; NOT the segment Taldau offers first, which is medium-sized only), discrete quarters 2015 Q1 on (not year-to-date). Balance (сальдо) = PROFIT + LOSS. National 2026 Q2: profit 6 895.2 bn, loss -780.9 bn, balance 6 114.3 bn. Sections O, P, Q, T, U not published.
